reviews.title: Oct 2025 Changes are Limiting
reviews.text: Love the app and company alignment with social justice values. However I’m disappointed they recently limited changes to the birth chart to once monthly. I don’t know my rising sign & have been experimenting with different times to narrow it down. I really hoped this app won’t make it more prohibitive for us with limited resources to access astrology.

reviews.title: Unresolved issue/Slow response
reviews.text: Have been unable to get on the app for a week and It is still unresolved. Communicating with a staff member for a week. She is offering suggestions but they are not panning out. I accidentally signed out of my app so I had re-sign in forgot my password. App takes you to a page to get a new password reset and says they will email you a code. They are not able to get the code sent to me, but somehow I can receive their other emails from them. I paid for an annual subscription that is not up until next year.

reviews.title: Chain app is broken
reviews.text: I put in all my birth details and triple checked that it was correct and it told me I was a Gemini rising and not a Taurus rising. Make it make sense??
